semantic.justification: Explicitly user-approved original setAllowedPaths/isForbidden and pre-open ACCES hook are ported with source read/write/execute lists, literal prefix matching, empty-read bypass, parent/realpath recursion, partial setup and abort environment order. Native openFilePath uses actual libc/MEMFS flags, open/stat/optional F_SETLK/cleanup and original handle state. Full active Forbidden::forbidden QA assertions and real create/truncate/exclusive/read-only/permissions/symlink/abort integration are exercised. Native pointer overread/OOM, SAL diagnostic/debug and other OS profiles remain unqualified; URL entry points, SvFileStream/TempFile/package/model/filter/UI acceptance remain unfinished.
